inputs.name: ticks

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.name: seed

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: MultiMapEnv builds one DuckietownEnv for each of the two maps loop_only_duckies and small_loop_only_duckies
MultiMapEnv copies the action space, observation space and reward range of the DuckietownEnv it built
Every reset advances cur_env_idx to the next environment and resets that environment
step delegates to the current environment, adds the reward and the step count to the totals, and clears the totals when the episode is done
seed seeds every environment and the environment's np_random, and returns [seed]
The step_count property returns the step count of the current environment
DuckietownEnv is a wrapper that controls the simulator with a velocity and a steering angle instead of differential drive motor velocities
DuckietownEnv sets the action space to Box(low=[-1, -1], high=[1, 1], dtype=float32)

DuckietownEnv.step reads the action as vel and angle, computes the two motor rotation rates from them and the wheel distance, converts those to duty cycles limited to [-limit, limit] and passes [left, right] to Simulator.step
The observation space is Box(low=0, high=255, shape=(camera_height, camera_width, 3), dtype=uint8): an RGB camera image
The default camera size is 640 by 480 pixels
The observation is the image rendered from the agent's camera
The simulator's default frame rate is 30
delta_time is 1.0 / frame_rate
The reward range is -1000 to 1000
The default max_steps is 1500
Simulator.step clips its action to [-1, 1] before applying it
update_physics increments step_count and advances timestamp by delta_time
An in-progress reward is speed * dot_dir - 10 * abs(lane distance) + 40 * collision penalty
An invalid pose terminates the episode and returns REWARD_INVALID_POSE
REWARD_INVALID_POSE is -1000
Reaching max_steps terminates the episode with reward 0
MultiMap-v0 is registered with entry point gym_duckietown.envs:MultiMapEnv and reward_threshold 400
Duckiebot-v0 is registered with entry point gym_duckietown.envs:DuckiebotEnv
DuckiebotEnv is the environment that is the actual real robot
DuckiebotEnv connects a ZMQ PAIR socket to the bridge node at serverAddr:serverPort
DuckiebotEnv sends each action over that socket as a JSON command

determinism.notes: a reset seed fixes the initial pose and the domain-randomization draws, and the pose update is deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the fake draws with Python's random.Random and upstream with numpy's RandomState, so a seed gives different trajectories on the two

gaps: kinematic differential-drive pose integration with geometric collision checks only: no force, tire-slip, actuator, sensor or noise dynamics; a collision terminates the episode instead of producing contact forces
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
the deployed observation is a rendered 480 x 640 x 3 OpenGL camera image; the fake returns one 3-value RGB pixel sample while its observation space still declares the real shape
the fake uses a straight placeholder lane and synthetic RGB values, not the geometry, textures, distortion or domain randomization of the two map files

the fake converts the velocity and the steering angle to the two wheel commands as DuckietownEnv.step does, with its default constants and the nominal wheel distance that upstream randomizes at every reset, and moves its pose from those commands with a placeholder speed and turn rate instead of the upstream dynamics
the fake draws with Python's random.Random and was not compared with the upstream OpenGL simulator or its numpy RandomState
snapshot and restore are not offered: MultiMapEnv exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the simulator state is kept and stays readable
